name: COR-DES-simple
source: Contemporary thin-strut DES, type A/B1 lesion. ABSORB III metallic arm 1-y TLF 6.1% all-comers; simple-lesion subsets 3-5%.

name: COR-DES-complex
source: Long, calcified, diabetic DES: 1-y TLF clusters at 10-14%.

name: COR-POBA
source: Balloon-only era: 1-y restenosis 30-40%, TLR of that order.

name: COR-DCB-small
source: Small-vessel DCB, non-inferior to DES in BASKET-SMALL 2; 1-y TLR ~8%.

name: COR-undersized
source: Severe underexpansion/malapposition. No clean trial; IVUS series put small minimum stent area at 2-4x the TLR of adequately expanded stents.

name: SFA-nitinol
source: Bare nitinol stent trials in moderate-length SFA: 1-y TLR 10-15%.

name: SFA-long-bare
source: Long bare nitinol across the flexion zone; fracture and restenosis both climb steeply with stented length.

name: BTK-DCB
source: Below-the-knee DCB in CLTI: 1-y CD-TLR around 10-15%.

name: CAR-stent
source: Carotid stenting: 1-y in-stent restenosis/TLR of a few percent.
